name: The Back Room
description: A 1920s speakeasy on the Lower East Side that still serves cocktails in teacups, hidden behind an unmarked door. The room feels tucked away and intimate, with vintage spirit and a quiet confidence. It’s a taste of old Manhattan culture through a modern young woman’s night out.

name: Prison Ship Martyrs' Monument
description: A 149-foot Doric column honoring 11,500 Americans who died on British prison ships during the Revolutionary War. The monument is a quiet, powerful landmark for reflection. It’s a solemn stop in Brooklyn that connects the city’s present with young women who care about history and memory.

name: Maleeha Cafe
address: Lower East Side, New York, NY
description: A women-owned Pakistani cafe creating space for community, pastries, and chai in NYC. It blends soft hospitality with bold conversation and comfort food. The cafe feels both homey and adventurous, offering a welcome pause for friends and creatives.

name: Happy Medium
description: An arts club in Chinatown where you order watercolors and friendship bracelets off an art cafe menu. Pottery, workshops, and crafty afternoons with friends make it feel playful and alive. It’s a creative hangout built for making, sharing, and discovering new local energy.
